subject: Assessment engagement models, onshore staffing and evidence retention
messages:
From: Matthew Reed <eng-sales@redlinesec.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + draft scope for annual appsec assessment

Hi Jonas / Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick intro call last week — appreciate the context on your microservice architecture and CI/CD cadence. Attached is a short proposal (redline-proposal-v1.pdf) with two engagement models:

- Onshore red team (3 testers, 5 business days): thorough hands-on assessment with real-time coordination windows.
- Hybrid (onshore lead + offshore analysts): cost-focused option that keeps sensitive exploit validation onshore.

A few clarifying questions so we can finalize scope and pricing:
1) Do you require onshore-only personnel for all testing (contractor background checks)?
2) Preferred blackout windows for production testing?
3) Evidence handling and retention policy (how long can we keep screen recordings / PoC artifacts)?

If you prefer, I can prepare a revised SOW with an onshore-only line item and an explicit evidence-retention addendum — DocuSign-ready.

Thanks,
Matt Reed
Engagement Lead, Redline Security
eng-sales@redlinesec.com
Attachment: redline-proposal-v1.pdf
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Matthew Reed <eng-sales@redlinesec.com>
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + draft scope for annual appsec assessment

Matt — thanks for the proposal. Short answers inline:

1) Onshore requirement: For any interactive exploit validation against customer data/PII we require onshore testers with US vetting. Non-sensitive discovery may be hybrid.

2) Blackout windows: Production testing must be scheduled outside 08:30–18:30 PT Mon–Fri; we can provide nightly windows and a maintenance-day slot.

3) Evidence retention: We would like a 90-day retention default, with longer-term storage available by request. Also need clear exportable artifacts for internal risk reviews (logs, PoC notes, screenshots).

Dev — can you confirm whether the CI/CD pipeline can spin up a replica env for destructive tests? If yes, we prefer destructive validation in isolated env.

If you can update the SOW with an onshore-only pricing line and the 90-day evidence clause, we can move procurement forward.

- Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Security PM, Redwood Inference
From: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Matthew Reed <eng-sales@redlinesec.com>, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + draft scope for annual appsec assessment

Folks — a couple of procurement/compliance items to add:

- Insurance: we need proof of professional liability / cyber E&O (minimum $5M) and current certs.
- Background checks: vendor must provide summary of vetting for onshore testers (site IDs or clearance summary).
- Evidence custody: Redline must have an S3 bucket encryption plan and a described deletion cadence; we will not accept vendor-controlled long-term storage without a contract clause.

Also: include a statement that test artifacts will be delivered via encrypted archive and retained only per the agreed retention schedule.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Matthew Reed <eng-sales@redlinesec.com>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@redlinesec.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + draft scope for annual appsec assessment (SOW v2 attached)

Evelyn / Jonas — thanks for the clarity. I've attached a revised SOW (redline-sow-v2.pdf) with the following updates:

- Onshore-only pricing line (detailed daily rates + per-exploit validation fee).
- Evidence handling addendum: encrypted S3 with server-side KMS, ephemeral storage by default, 90-day retention and secure export option.
- Insurance and background-check appendix (we'll provide scanned certs and vetting summaries once you confirm).
- Test windows and non-production destructive guidance.

DocuSign link is ready if you want to proceed with the onshore engagement: https://docusign.net/sign/abc123-redline-sow

Attachment: redline-sow-v2.pdf

Let me know if procurement needs any additional vendor docs and I'll loop in our contracts team.

Regards,
Matt Reed
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 10:30:00 -0800

Notes for procurement: target start window mid-February; estimated spend $85k–$120k depending on final exploitation days. Please request vendor W-9 and proof of insurance, and confirm their vendor portal onboarding steps.

-Jonas
